generate_joint_space_min_jerk: generate a minimum jerk trajectory in joint space from start to goal positions with specified duration and frequency
generate_cartesian_space_min_jerk: generate a minimum jerk trajectory in Cartesian space between two transformation poses with position and rotation
generate_position_min_jerk: generate a minimum jerk trajectory through 3D XYZ space from a start to goal position
generate_cartesian_target_joint_min_jerk: generate a joint space trajectory from a Cartesian end-effector goal pose using inverse kinematics and null space correction
min_jerk_spaces: generate a 1D minimum jerk position velocity and acceleration trajectory from 0 to 1 over N steps
